title: Can Chitti make 5072 in a different way?
description: Creative Chitti has buttons from plus one up to plus ten lakh, so it can reach a number in many ways. The video trades one thousand for ten hundreds to find a new way to make five thousand seventy two. Keeko raises a hand, thinking that ten presses of ten make a thousand.
teaching_notes: One idea: ten presses of one button make the same amount as one press of the next bigger button, so a trade gives a new way to reach the same number. Ask the class to say what ten presses of each button make before any trade. Watch for students who trade a thousand for ten presses of the ten button.

source: Two ways to get 5072 are (50 × 100) + (7 × 10) + (2 × 1) and (3 × 1000) + (20 × 100) + (72 × 1). Find a different way to get 5072 and write an expression for the same
video_script.why: The child has counted presses for one button at a time and now combines several buttons.
video_script.substitution: Ten presses of one button make the same amount as one press of the next bigger button, so trading one big press for ten smaller presses gives a new way to reach the same number.
video_script.anchor: Creative Chitti can make 5072 in many ways: find a different way and write its expression
video_script.wrong_answer: ten presses of ten make a thousand
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko trades a thousand for ten presses of the ten button. Ten presses of ten make only a hundred; a thousand needs ten presses of the hundred button.
video_script.payoff_line: Four thousands, ten hundreds, seven tens and two ones make five thousand seventy two

final_answer.spoken: Four thousands, ten hundreds, seven tens and two ones

hold_back: Four thousands, ten hundreds, seven tens and two ones
never_show: the two ways already printed in the book as the answer
maths_rules: the slip: ten presses of +10 make 100, not 1000
video_script.design: One idea: ten presses of a button equal one press of the next bigger button, so a trade makes a new way. Wrong idea: Keeko trades a thousand for ten presses of the ten button. The anchor stays all video; the working band builds in the idea part; no hard clear.
